description: One open-ended production brief: build a complete, self-contained product webpage for a local-AI operations persona. Graded by deterministic render, console, asset, and style checks; no LLM judge.

hardware.profile: BigRig: Intel Core i5-13600K (14 cores / 20 threads), 30 GB DDR5, AMD RX 9060 XT 16 GB + NVIDIA RTX 3060 12 GB
notes: Dual-GPU desktop; integrated UHD 770 carries the display so both dGPUs stay available for compute
952 GB NVMe root with large headroom for working sets

files: index.html (single self-contained page, inline CSS and JS)
checks: Headless Chromium render: zero console errors
No gradients, emoji, or substituted dashes in the final page
All local font references resolve against the shipped fonts directory

notes: Completion task: the score records that the page was produced and passes its checks, not model quality
No decode or prefill throughput was measured in this run
JetBrains Mono falls back to the system mono stack when absent; the three Ubuntu faces are committed with the page
